sentences.text: Learned APP waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of respondent-State.

2. The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with C.R. No. 11205047230117 of 2023 registered with the Pragpar Police Station, District Kachchh-West Bhuj for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2), 294(b) and 506(2) of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 3. Learned advocate Mr. Varandani appearing on behalf of the applicant has submitted that the so called incident has occurred for the period between 04.04.2023 to 14.04.2023 and FIR was registered on 14.04.2023 and in connection with the same, the applicant was arrested on 14.04.2023 and since then, he is in judicial custody.

It is also submitted that the investigation is already completed and the present application NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/13141/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/03/2024 undefined is filed after submission of the charge-sheet.

1 submits that case was committed to the court of learned Sessions Judge and the trial has already been commenced and the evidence of the complainant-victim was recorded, wherein she has has not supported the case of the prosecution and she has been declared hostile by the concerned learned APP.
Learned advocate submitted that considering the above stated factual aspect, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable terms and conditions.
4. Learned APP appearing on behalf of the respondent-State has opposed the present bail application.
It is submitted that the role of the present applicant is clearly spelt out from the body of the compilation of the charge sheet papers.
He further submitted that considering the role attributed by the present applicant, the present application may not be considered.
5. Learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.
6. I have perused the police papers as well as documents produced by the applicant along with the memo of the application.
It is found out from the record that the applicant is jail since 14.04.2023.
The investigation is already completed and the present application is filed after submission of the charge-sheet.

It is found out that in connection with the aforesaid case, trial has already been commenced and during the course of trial, the evidence of the complainant-victim has been recorded, wherein she has has not supported the case of the prosecution and she has been declared hostile.
I have considered the deposition of the victim girl as also considered NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/13141/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/03/2024 undefined the role attributed to the present applicant - accused.
Therefore considering the above stated factual aspect, I am inclined to exercise the discretion in favour of the applicant.

7. This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012]1 SCC 40 as well as in case of Satender Kumar Antil v. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr. reported in (2022)10 SCC 51.
8.

sentences.text: The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.
If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.
Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.
11. At the trial, the trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature qua the evidence at this stage made by this Court while enlarging the applicant on bail.
12. The present application stands allowed accordingly.
Rule made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.

(DIVYESH A. JOSHI,J) SALIM/
